arrangement.depth: The stops sit one behind the other, the first delivery at the door: to reach the next one, the one in front has to be taken out.
arrangement.grid: The stops sit in side-by-side lanes, each lane holding a queue in delivery order: the first deliveries — one per lane — are all at the door, and none sits behind another that has not left yet.
arrangement.lanes: Each stop has its own lane across the width, and all of them reach the door — any one can be reached without moving the others.
arrangement.weightWon: ⚠️ Lanes would fit this cargo, but the weight went past half of the vehicle's ceiling: with the load concentrated on one side of the door, the front axle lightens. Stability won over access.

cargoLayers.bedFromReference: The scale comes from the vehicle type catalogue, not from the fiche: this truck has no bed measurements, and the same type varies by up to double.

legend.measured: Solid colour: box measured with a tape.
legend.notes: One colour per invoice: each invoice has its own colour in the bed — tap the invoice on the delivery card to light only its boxes.
legend.presumed: Dotted outline: presumed box, derived from volume.
legend.split: Red outline: split cargo, on top of the inner region.
legend.complement: Copper dashed outline: complement box, outside the recommended map.
legend.complementStrong: Thicker copper line: complement box that also breaks the unloading order.
legend.overEarlier: Solid light outline: box on top of a delivery that unloads earlier — the "Boxes on top" list says at which stop it moves out of the way.
legend.reusedColors: {{count}} invoices reuse another invoice colour: this trip has more invoices than the palette has colours.
legend.select: Tap a box to light up its whole invoice; tap a lit box again to switch off just that one.

cargoLayers.missingBed: No cargo drawing: this vehicle has no bed length, width and height on its record.
cargoLayers.mostlyPresumed: Almost no box on this trip has been measured: the drawing shows volume, not the arrangement of boxes that exist.

notes.doorIsNotAWall: The door face does not count as support: with it open, the stack leaning on it falls — onto whoever opened it.
notes.heightBeforeDepth: Inside each lane the cargo rises to the ceiling before moving toward the back, so nobody has to climb into the bed to reach the last box.
notes.stackConfined: In the middle of the block the stack rose higher: surrounded by cargo and wall, it has nowhere to tip over.
notes.stackSecured: The driver straps the cargo down, so the stack rises to the bed ceiling — the strap holds what the shape alone would not.
notes.stackStability: At the loose edge of the cargo the stack stops at three times the smallest base measure: above that it tips over on a sharp turn.
notes.title: Why the drawing came out this way

gap.CITY_WITHOUT_REGION: destination without a registered freight zone
gap.DRIVER_RATE_MISSING_FOR_CLASS: the zone has no price for this vehicle class — check the Regions tab
gap.DRIVER_ZONE_NOT_COVERED: the driver does not cover the destination zone — fix it on the driver record
gap.DRIVER_ZONE_PRICED_FROM_TABLE: table price: the driver does not have this zone — add it to the driver record
gap.DRIVER_ROUTE_AMBIGUOUS: tied routes: the trip cities match more than one route of the table equally — choose which one applies
gap.DRIVER_ROUTE_TIE_HIGHEST_RATE: routes tied on the number of trip cities — the highest price among the matching bands was used
gap.ICMS_CST_UNSUPPORTED: the emission profile uses CST 60, which the product does not issue
gap.NO_EMISSION_PROFILE: no emission profile governs the invoice (none matches, or two tie) — check the CT-e profiles
gap.HELPER_DAILY_RATE_MISSING: the helper has no own daily rate and no company rate is set
gap.HELPER_JOURNEY_UNKNOWN: route not planned yet — no journey to count the helper's days
gap.HELPER_JOURNEY_WITHOUT_RETURN: the frozen journey only covers the outbound leg — the return leg was not recorded
gap.NO_DRIVER_RATE: no rate registered for the aggregate route
gap.NO_FREIGHT_RULE: no freight rule for the destination
gap.NO_FUEL_BASELINE: vehicle average consumption yields no cost
gap.NO_FUEL_CONSUMPTION: vehicle has no average consumption on file
gap.NO_FUEL_PRICE: no price for this vehicle's fuel
gap.NO_PLANNED_DISTANCE: route not calculated yet — fuel comes after
gap.NO_PLANNED_DURATION: route duration unknown — inform how many daily allowances the trip pays
gap.NO_TRIP_DRIVER: trip with no driver — nobody to pay the daily allowance to
gap.NO_VEHICLE: trip with no vehicle — pick the truck so the numbers can close
gap.SALARIED_CREW_MEMBER: salaried driver on board — a period cost, not a trip cost
gap.TOLL_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_SUGGESTION: toll is only computed once the trip exists
gap.TOLL_PARTIAL: a toll plaza on the route has no known tariff — the total only sums the others
